name: ninthspace-marketplace
description: A comprehensive marketplace for my development tools

plugins.name: noteplan
plugins.description: Search and query NotePlan content across markdown files and Spaces (team/shared) SQLite database

plugins.name: php-lsp
plugins.description: PHP Language Server (intelephense) integration for Claude Code via lsp-mcp-server. Semantic code intelligence: go-to-definition, find references, hover, diagnostics, rename, and more.

plugins.name: cpm-next
plugins.description: Six skills for planning and building with Claude Code: party (discussion with specialist personas), plan (brief, spec and epics from whatever already exists), review (independent challenge of the epics), do (build, verify and audit each story to a stated finish line), library (reference documents and promoted retro lessons), status (where things stand and what to run next).

plugins.name: js-simplifier
plugins.description: Simplify and improve JavaScript and TypeScript code across an entire codebase — modern syntax, code quality, and structural improvements

plugins.name: filament-mockup
plugins.description: Build static, high-fidelity Filament v5 admin mockups from a brief or spec for stakeholder sign-off, before scaffolding any real Filament/Laravel code

plugins.name: whats-next
plugins.description: Live pane and band showing the work left in the current repo's cpm-next epics (docs/epics), in recommended order of execution, with an on-demand next-steps note from Claude.

plugins.name: generated-files
plugins.description: Pane listing the HTML, SVG, image, Office and PDF files Claude wrote this session, each with Open and Reveal buttons.

plugins.name: weather
plugins.description: Current weather (condition and temperature) for a place you set, in the prompt footer, refreshed every 15 minutes.

plugins.name: cpm-next-models
plugins.description: Keeps a cpm-next skill's frontmatter model and effort for every turn of its run, including your replies to its questions, and runs `do all` at high effort; released when another skill runs, you switch model or effort, or /clear.

plugins.name: cpm-next-progress
plugins.description: Checks a claude.ai progress tracker for a cpm-next spec's epics against the epic docs, in the build order you set, and tells Claude which rows to update; it never writes to the tracker itself.

plugins.name: plugin-sync
plugins.description: Reloads plugins in every open Claude Code session when a ninthspace-marketplace plugin is updated, so each session picks up the new version without a manual /reload-plugins.
